messages:
sasha (eng-releases): FYI team 1: new partitioned-rollout policy + security-patch lane for this release train. Key points: partitioned rollouts for stateful infra and embedding model swaps, separate "security-patch" fast lane for vetted CVE fixes during freeze. Short bullets below and link to handbook.

deploy-bot: Release freeze window updated for this train: Sat 02:00-05:00 UTC (3h). Services with tag `high-traffic` default to partitioned rollouts.

lee (release-manager): Partitioned rollout meaning: you can split traffic by shard/region or user cohort (examples in the handbook). Required: canary manifest + traffic map file in the PR and a rollback plan. Minimum canary: 2 shards or 5% traffic, whichever higher.

omar (security): Security-patch lane flow: if a CVE fix is urgent and backward-compatible, open `/patch-fastlane --svc <svc> --cve <CVE-ID> --owner @<you> --reason "<short>"`. Security will triage within 15m and can approve a fast deploy during freeze with audit token attached. Non-CVE or non-backwards changes must follow normal canary.

harper (sre): Monitoring notes: for partitioned rollouts, we enable per-shard tracing and a short retention window of 48h for the shard logs. Synthetic checks run every 2m on active shards. If any shard crosses error rate 0.4% for 3 checks, that shard is cut and rolled back.

ryan (eng): Question: for embedding model swaps that change tokenization, can we use a partition by user-id hash to route 10% to the new model? Any special migration steps?

lee (release-manager): Yes, user-id hash partitioning is allowed. Please include a compatibility test in the canary manifest to compare embeddings for a sample set and attach the eval snapshot in the PR. If tokenization changes, include a deprecation note and client-side migration plan.

omar (security): Also: key rotation window shortened for fastlane approvals. If a patch touches KMS permissions we need an explicit security sign-off and we will not approve via fastlane.

emily (devex): Can I get a 2-line changelog for the weekly digest? Something copy-pastable.

sasha (eng-releases): Put this: "Partitioned rollouts for high-traffic services, new CVE fastlane `/patch-fastlane` with 15m triage SLA, and per-shard tracing + synthetic probes during rollouts."

audit-bot: Policy record created: partitioned-rollouts-v1 and patch-fastlane-v1. Audit refs: https://redwood.internal/audit/partitioned-rollouts-2026, https://redwood.internal/audit/patch-fastlane-2026

harper (sre): Quick ops tip: include `--observe-dashboard <dash-id>` in your rollforward command so the release manager can follow metrics automatically.

ryan (eng): ack. We'll draft the canary manifest and a small smoke test suite today.

sasha (eng-releases): Thanks all 1 1 please read the handbook link and ping here if anything blocks. We'll finalize the policy EOD unless major concerns come up.
file_description: announcement: partitioned rollout policy and security-patch fast lane for the release train, with canary/monitoring guidance and audit links
